cases.prompt: Compare two inventory layouts using the same identity and data. Do not implement both as finished products.

criteria.description: Keep facts and constraints comparable while varying meaningful layout decisions.
Preserve brand identity and bounded comparison scope.
Make selection and implementation boundaries clear.

cases.prompt: Recreate a screenshot exactly, but its image and viewport scale are not supplied.

criteria.description: Obtain or clarify missing fidelity and scale evidence.
Do not claim exact fidelity without a target.
Do not propose a full-page image as the final interface.

cases.prompt: Review the inventory page visually. Do not modify files.

criteria.description: Tie findings to available evidence and label missing browser inspection.
Assess the working surface rather than inventing a marketing redesign.

cases.prompt: Polish the inventory page and report what you verified. Browser tools are unavailable.

criteria.description: Do not claim rendered or independent review occurred.
Preserve existing identity and task hierarchy.
Make the change reviewable and name remaining visual checks.

cases.prompt: Plan loading, no-results, and failed-save states before implementation.

criteria.description: Distinguish the requested states and recovery paths.
Keep the main object and action understandable.
Do not claim planned workflows were executed.
